hooks.name: Run simulation tests after editing game rules
hooks.description: When a file in src/sim/ is saved, asks the agent to run the simulation's property tests and act on any failure.

action.prompt: A game-rules file in src/sim/ was just saved. Run `npm run test:sim`. If a property test fails, read fast-check's shrunk counterexample, decide whether the code, the property or the requirement in .kiro/specs is wrong, fix it, keep the counterexample as an example test, and add a row to Documents/kiro-usage-log.md. If every test passes, say so in one line and carry on.
